item.title: Scott Pilgrim EX Review - Earning the Power of Friendship | The Nerd Stash
item.description: TNS: In Scott Pilgrim EX, our Toronto hero makes new friends to save his bandmates across time and space against challenging boss fights.

item.title: New Legends from Every Era in MLB The Show 26 Revealed
item.description: From heroic hitters to powerful pitchers, choose from over 220 Legends spanning every era of baseball to build your legendary lineup and write your own history in MLB The Show 26.

item.title: Highguard will be permanently shut down on March 12
item.description: Highguard official Twitter: "Today were sharing difficult news. We have made the decision to permanently shut down Highguard on March 12. Since launch, more than 2 million players stepped into Highguards world. You shared feedback, created content, and many believed in what we were building. For that, we are deeply grateful."

item.title: Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time Remake Trophies Appear on PlayStation Network
item.description: The canceled Prince of Persia: The Sands of Time Remake has appeared on PlayStation Network as its trophy list goes live; however, it doesn't mean the game is returning.

item.title: The Unity Asset Store is ditching publishers based in China, Hong Kong, and Macau
item.description: Assets from publishers based in China, Hong Kong, and Macau will be delisted from the Unity Asset Store on March 31, 2026.

item.title: Blue Prince Launch Trailer Nintendo Switch 2
item.description: Discover the secrets and mysteries that Mount Holly hold. Play Blue Prince today on Nintendo Switch 2.

item.title: Minishoot Adventures Indie World Showcase 3.3.2026
item.description: Minishoot' Adventures takes the joy of shooter action and combines it with the feeling of going on an incredible quest, as if it was a classic from the 8-bit era. Fight to rescue your friends as you explore a handcrafted worldfrom a shiny overworld to the deepest cavernsimproving your ship and taking down dungeon bosses along the way.

item.title: Deadzone: Rogue Indie World Showcase 3.3.2026
item.description: Step into a forsaken space station in Deadzone: Rogue, a fast-paced roguelite FPS where every run is a heated fight for survival. Explore shifting corridors, scavenge and combine experimental weaponry and augments, and destroy biomechanical swarms that evolve with each encounterwhether youre venturing alone or teaming up with friends in co-op.

item.title: Tides of Tomorrows Brilliant Idea Makes Every Choice Matter Twice | COGconnected
item.description: Tides of Tomorrow takes a unique approach to storytelling, and after being hands-on for a few hours, its shaping up to be something special.

item.title: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered Review - Clunky Classic | COGconnected
item.description: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered brings a titan of video games past back from the grave, but some of the gameplay is dead on arrival.
